tr.en: My darling, it’s very cold this year. Dress warmly, and don’t go outside with your head uncovered.
tr.fr: Mon cœur, il fait très froid cette année. Habille-toi bien et ne sors pas les cheveux mouillés.
tr.es: Cariño, este año hace un frío tremendo. Abrígate bien y no salgas con el pelo mojado.
tr.it: Amore mio, quest’anno fa davvero freddo. Vestiti bene e non uscire con i capelli bagnati.

literal: My heart, the cold this year is harsh. Dress well and don’t go out with your hair exposed.

notes.literal: my heart
notes.meaning: A tender endearment, like “my darling.”

fr.literal: Mon cœur, le froid cette année est rude ; habille-toi bien et ne sors pas avec les cheveux mouillés.

notes.literal: mon cœur
notes.meaning: A tender way of saying “my darling” or “my dear.”

es.literal: Mi corazón, mira, el frío este año es duro; vístete bien y no salgas con tu pelo mojado.

notes.literal: my heart
notes.meaning: a tender endearment: “cariño”

notes.literal: uncertain; possibly wet or damp
notes.meaning: In this context, it most likely refers to going outside with wet hair.

it.literal: Cuore mio, quest’anno il freddo è duro; vestiti bene e non uscire con i capelli bagnati.

notes.literal: my heart
notes.meaning: my darling; a tender endearment

notes.literal: unclear; possibly wet or loose
notes.meaning: In this context, it most likely means wet hair.

tr.en: The sweet you sent me, my girl—I swear, I even licked it with my finger!
tr.fr: La douceur que tu m’as envoyée, ma fille, je l’ai vraiment dégustée jusqu’à la dernière miette, même avec le doigt.
tr.es: El dulce que me mandaste, hija mía, te juro que hasta lo rebañé con el dedo.
tr.it: Il dolce che mi hai mandato, figlia mia, giuro che l’ho leccato persino con il dito.

literal: The sweet you sent me, my daughter, I swear I licked it with my finger.

notes.literal: my daughter
notes.meaning: A tender way for a grandparent to address a granddaughter: “my girl.”

fr.literal: La douceur que tu m’as envoyée, ma fille, je l’ai vraiment léchée avec mon doigt.

notes.literal: my daughter
notes.meaning: A tender way for a grandparent to address their granddaughter.

notes.literal: I swear, really
notes.meaning: Adds emphasis and sincerity; here it playfully stresses how much she enjoyed the sweet.

es.literal: El dulce que me enviaste, hija mía, te juro que hasta lo lamí con el dedo.

notes.literal: I swear, even
notes.meaning: A warm emphatic expression meaning “I really did” or “I even…”; here it humorously emphasizes how much she enjoyed the sweet.

it.literal: Il dolce che mi hai mandato, figlia mia, giuro che l’ho leccato persino con il dito.

notes.literal: my daughter
notes.meaning: A tender way for a grandparent to address a granddaughter or beloved young woman.

notes.literal: by God / I swear
notes.meaning: An emphatic expression meaning “I swear” or “truly.”

tr.en: Don't keep stressing about the exam. Whatever God has decreed will happen.
tr.fr: Ne te fais pas de souci pour l’examen, ce qui doit arriver arrivera.
tr.es: No sigas preocupándote por el examen; lo que Dios ha dispuesto es lo que sucederá.
tr.it: Non continuare a preoccuparti per l’esame: sarà quel che Dio ha stabilito.

literal: Don't keep worrying your head about the exam; what God wrote is what is going to happen.

notes.expression: lli kteb llah howa lli ghadi ykoun
notes.literal: What God wrote is what will happen.
notes.meaning: Whatever is meant to happen will happen; accept it as being in God's hands.

fr.literal: Ne continue pas à inquiéter ta tête à propos de l’examen ; ce que Dieu a écrit, c’est ce qui sera.

notes.expression: lli kteb Allah howa lli ghadi ykoun
notes.literal: What God has written is what will be.
notes.meaning: It was meant to be; accept it and don’t worry.

es.literal: No sigas preocupándote por el examen; lo que Dios ha escrito es lo que sucederá.

notes.literal: lo que Dios ha escrito
notes.meaning: what is destined to happen; leave it in God's hands

it.literal: Non continuare a preoccupare la tua testa per l’esame; ciò che Dio ha scritto è ciò che sarà.

notes.expression: lli kteb Allah huwa lli ghadi ykun
notes.literal: What God has written is what will be.
notes.meaning: It was meant to be; leave the outcome in God's hands.

tr.en: Go on, my boy. I hope things go smoothly for you and doors open for you.
tr.fr: Va, mon grand. Que tout se passe bien pour toi et que les portes s’ouvrent à toi.
tr.es: Ve, hijo mío. Que todo te salga bien y se te abran las puertas.
tr.it: Vai, figlio mio. Che tutto ti vada per il meglio e che ti si aprano tutte le porte.

literal: Go, my son. May God make it easy for you and open the door for you.

notes.literal: May God make it easy for you.
notes.meaning: A common wish for good luck and for things to go smoothly.

fr.literal: Va, mon garçon. Que Dieu te facilite les choses et t’ouvre la porte.

notes.literal: Que Dieu te facilite les choses
notes.meaning: Bonne chance, j’espère que tout se passera bien pour toi.

notes.literal: Qu’Il t’ouvre la porte
notes.meaning: Que des possibilités et de la réussite s’ouvrent à toi.

es.literal: Ve, hijo mío, que Dios te lo haga fácil y te abra la puerta.

notes.expression: Allah ysehel 3lik w y7ell lik l bab
notes.literal: May God make it easy for you and open the door for you.
notes.meaning: A blessing wishing someone good luck, smooth progress, and success or opportunities.

it.literal: Vai, figlio mio; che Dio ti renda tutto facile e ti apra la porta.

notes.literal: May God make things easy for you
notes.meaning: Good luck; I hope everything goes smoothly for you.

notes.literal: May He open the door for you
notes.meaning: May opportunities and success come your way.

tr.en: You’ve stopped calling, and we’ve even started asking the neighbors about you.
tr.fr: Tu n’appelles plus, au point qu’on a fini par demander de tes nouvelles aux voisins.
tr.es: Ya no llamas, y hemos acabado preguntando por ti a los vecinos.
tr.it: Non ci chiami più; siamo arrivati persino a chiedere tue notizie ai vicini.

literal: You no longer call, until we started asking the neighbors about you.

fr.literal: Tu n’appelles plus, jusqu’à ce qu’on se mette à demander de tes nouvelles aux voisins.

es.literal: Ya no llamabas, hasta que terminamos preguntando por ti a los vecinos.

it.literal: Non hai più chiamato, al punto che abbiamo iniziato a chiedere di te ai vicini.

tr.en: We’re waiting for you at home, and this year’s olives look delicious.
tr.fr: Notre maison t’attend, et les olives de cette année donnent envie.
tr.es: Te esperamos en casa; las aceitunas de este año tienen una pinta deliciosa.
tr.it: Casa nostra ti aspetta, e le olive di quest’anno fanno venire l’acquolina in bocca.

literal: Our home is waiting for you, and this year's olives make you crave them.

fr.literal: Notre maison t’attend, et les olives de cette année mettent en appétit.

es.literal: Nuestra casa te espera, y las aceitunas de este año abren el apetito.

it.literal: Casa nostra ti aspetta, e le olive di quest’anno fanno venire voglia.

tr.en: I didn’t get enough time with you this summer. Come back early this time.
tr.fr: Mon cœur, je n’ai pas eu assez de toi cet été. Reviens tôt cette fois-ci.
tr.es: Cariño, este verano no tuve suficiente tiempo contigo; vuelve pronto esta vez.
tr.it: Quest’estate non mi è bastato averti qui; torna presto, stavolta.

literal: My eyes didn’t get enough of you in the summer; come back early this time.

notes.literal: my eyes
notes.meaning: An affectionate way to address someone dear, like “my dear.”

fr.literal: Mes yeux ne se sont pas rassasiés de toi en été ; reviens tôt cette fois-ci.

notes.literal: mes yeux
notes.meaning: un tendre terme d’affection, comme « mon cœur » ou « mon cher ».

es.literal: Mis ojos no se saciaron de ti en verano; vuelve temprano esta vez.

notes.literal: mis ojos
notes.meaning: Un término cariñoso: «cariño» o «mi vida».

it.literal: I miei occhi non si sono saziati di te quest’estate; torna presto questa volta.

notes.literal: My eyes weren’t filled up with you.
notes.meaning: I missed you and didn’t get enough time with you.

tr.en: He’s grown up and become a man. May God protect him from the evil eye.
tr.fr: Il a grandi et il est devenu un homme. Que Dieu le protège du mauvais œil.
tr.es: Ha crecido y se ha convertido en todo un hombre. Que Dios lo proteja del mal de ojo.
tr.it: È cresciuto ed è diventato un uomo. Che Dio lo protegga dal malocchio.

literal: He grew up and became a man; may God guard him from the eye.

notes.literal: May God guard him from the eye.
notes.meaning: A prayer asking God to protect him from the evil eye.

fr.literal: Il a grandi et est devenu un homme, que Dieu le garde de l’œil.

notes.literal: Que Dieu le garde de l’œil
notes.meaning: A protective blessing asking God to protect him from the evil eye.

es.literal: Creció y se convirtió en un hombre; que Dios lo vigile del ojo.

notes.literal: May God watch over him from the eye.
notes.meaning: A protective blessing asking God to protect him from the evil eye, often said when admiring someone's growth or appearance.

it.literal: È cresciuto ed è diventato un uomo; che Dio lo protegga dal malocchio.

notes.expression: الله يحضيه من العين (Allah y7dih men l-3in)
notes.literal: May God protect him from the eye.
notes.meaning: A prayer asking God to protect him from the evil eye.

tr.en: Your aunt is a little unwell. Give her a call and cheer her up.
tr.fr: Ta tante est un peu malade. Appelle-la, ça lui fera plaisir de t’entendre.
tr.es: Tu tía está un poco enferma. Llámala; oír tu voz la alegrará.
tr.it: Tua zia non si sente tanto bene. Chiamala, le farà piacere sentirti.

literal: Your aunt is a little sick; call her and make her happy with your voice.

fr.literal: Ta tante est un peu malade, appelle-la et réjouis-la par ta présence.

es.literal: Tu tía está un poco enferma; llámala y alégrala con tu voz.

it.literal: Tua zia è un po’ malata; chiamala e falle piacere con la tua presenza.

tr.en: Do good and expect nothing in return.
tr.fr: Fais le bien sans rien attendre en retour.
tr.es: Haz el bien sin esperar nada a cambio.
tr.it: Fai del bene senza aspettarti nulla in cambio.

literal: Do good and throw it into the sea; don’t expect anything from anyone.

notes.expression: Dir lkhir w kbbou f lb7er
notes.literal: Do good and throw it into the sea.
notes.meaning: Do good without expecting anything back; let the deed go once it’s done.

fr.literal: Fais le bien et jette-le à la mer, n’attends rien de personne.

notes.expression: Dir l-khir w kebbo f l-b7er
notes.literal: Fais le bien et jette-le à la mer.
notes.meaning: Fais le bien sans attendre de récompense ni de reconnaissance.

es.literal: Haz el bien y échalo al mar; no esperes nada de nadie.

notes.expression: Dir l-khir w kebbou f l-b7er
notes.literal: Haz el bien y échalo al mar.
notes.meaning: Es un proverbio que anima a hacer el bien sin esperar recompensa ni agradecimiento.

it.literal: Fai il bene e buttalo nel mare, non aspettare niente da nessuno.

notes.expression: dir l-khir w kbbou f l-b7er
notes.literal: Fai del bene e buttalo in mare.
notes.meaning: Fai del bene senza aspettarti nulla in cambio; come se lo lasciassi andare.

tr.en: I always tell them, “This boy is as stubborn as his grandpa.”
tr.fr: Je leur dis toujours : ce garçon est têtu comme son grand-père.
tr.es: Siempre les digo: este chico es tan terco como su abuelo.
tr.it: Dico sempre loro: questo ragazzo è testardo come suo nonno.

literal: I always tell them: this boy, his head is hard like his grandfather’s.

notes.literal: his head is hard
notes.meaning: He’s stubborn or hard-headed.

fr.literal: Je leur dis toujours : ce garçon a la tête dure comme son grand-père.

notes.literal: il a la tête dure
notes.meaning: il est têtu

es.literal: Siempre digo a ellos: este chico, su cabeza es dura como su abuelo.

notes.literal: his head is hard
notes.meaning: He is stubborn.

it.literal: Dico sempre a loro: questo ragazzo, la sua testa è dura come suo nonno.

tr.en: Everything is quiet here; it just hasn’t rained.
tr.fr: Ici, tout va bien, c’est juste qu’il n’a pas plu.
tr.es: Aquí todo está tranquilo, solo que no ha querido llover.
tr.it: Qui va tutto tranquillo, solo che non piove.

literal: The world is calm here; it’s just that the rain didn’t want to fall.

es.literal: Aquí la vida está tranquila; solo que la lluvia no ha querido caer.

it.literal: Qui va tutto tranquillo, solo che la pioggia non ha voluto cadere.

tr.en: Send me the wedding photos. I want to see who came.
tr.fr: Envoie-moi les photos du mariage, je veux voir qui est venu.
tr.es: Envíame las fotos de la boda. Quiero ver quién fue.
tr.it: Mandami le foto del matrimonio, voglio vedere chi è venuto.

literal: Send me the pictures of the wedding; I want to see who came.

fr.literal: Envoie-moi les photos du mariage, je veux voir qui est venu.

es.literal: Envíame las fotos de la boda; quiero ver quién vino.

it.literal: Mandami le fotografie del matrimonio, voglio vedere chi è venuto.

tr.en: Tell your mother to pick up my medicine from the pharmacy and bring it with her.
tr.fr: Dis à ta maman de rapporter mon médicament de la pharmacie.
tr.es: Dile a tu mamá que traiga mi medicina de la farmacia.
tr.it: Di' a tua madre di portare con sé la mia medicina dalla farmacia.

literal: Tell your mother to bring my medicine with her from the pharmacist.

fr.literal: Dis à ta maman d’apporter avec elle mon médicament de la pharmacie.

es.literal: Dile a tu mamá que traiga consigo mi medicina de la farmacia.

it.literal: Di' a tua madre di portare con sé la mia medicina dalla farmacia.

tr.en: I hope you achieve what you're hoping for, my son, and that I live to see your children before I die.
tr.fr: Que Dieu te permette d’accomplir tout ce que tu souhaites, mon grand, et que je puisse voir tes enfants avant de mourir.
tr.es: Que Dios te conceda eso que tienes en mente, hijo mío, y que pueda ver a tus hijos antes de morir.
tr.it: Che Dio ti conceda ciò che desideri, figlio mio, e che io possa vedere i tuoi figli prima di morire.

literal: May God bring you to that thing that's on your mind, my son, and may I see your children before I die.

notes.expression: الله يوصلك لداك الشي اللي فبالك
notes.literal: May God bring you to the thing that's on your mind.
notes.meaning: A heartfelt wish that you achieve what you're hoping for.

fr.literal: Que Dieu te conduise vers ce que tu as en tête, mon garçon, et que je voie tes enfants avant que je meure.

notes.expression: الله يوصلك لداك الشي اللي فبالك (Allah ywasslek l-dak shi lli f balk)
notes.literal: Que Dieu te conduise vers ce que tu as en tête.
notes.meaning: A heartfelt prayer wishing someone success in achieving what they hope for.

notes.literal: Mon garçon / mon fils.
notes.meaning: A tender way for a grandparent to address a grandson.

es.literal: Que Dios te haga llegar a aquello que tienes en mente, hijo mío, y que vea a tus hijos antes de morir.

notes.expression: الله يوصلك لداك الشي اللي فبالك (Allah ywasslek l-dak shi lli f balek)
notes.literal: May God get you to that thing that is in your mind.
notes.meaning: A heartfelt prayer that you achieve what you hope for.

notes.literal: My boy / my son.
notes.meaning: A tender grandparent's way of addressing a grandson.

it.literal: Che Dio ti conduca a ciò che hai in mente, figlio mio, e che io veda i tuoi figli prima di morire.

notes.expression: Allah ywaslek l dak shi lli f balek
notes.literal: May God get you to that thing which is in your mind
notes.meaning: May God grant you what you wish for.

notes.literal: my boy / my son
notes.meaning: A tender grandparent's way of addressing a grandson.

tr.en: Are you still eating nothing but street food? You look pale in the picture.
tr.fr: Tu manges toujours uniquement de la nourriture de la rue ? Sur la photo, tu as le visage tout jaune.
tr.es: ¿Sigues comiendo solo comida de la calle? En la foto tienes la cara muy pálida.
tr.it: Mangi ancora solo cibo da strada? Nella foto hai il viso tutto giallo.

literal: Are you still eating only the food from the street? Your face has turned yellow in the picture.

fr.literal: Est-ce que tu manges encore seulement la nourriture de la rue ? Ton visage est devenu jaune sur la photo.

es.literal: ¿Todavía sigues comiendo solamente la comida de la calle? Tu cara se ha vuelto amarilla en la foto.

it.literal: Mangi ancora soltanto il cibo della strada? Il tuo viso è diventato giallo nella foto.

tr.en: Even beauty wasn’t spared by the first one… and you’re beautiful and sensible.
tr.fr: La beauté ne t’a pas oubliée : tu es belle et pleine de bon sens.
tr.es: Eres guapa y sensata; no hay nadie más bella que tú.
tr.it: La bellezza non si è dimenticata di te, Lola: sei bella e giudiziosa.

literal: Even beauty did not miss it, the first one, and you are beautiful and sensible.

notes.literal: Even beauty, the first one did not miss it.
notes.meaning: uncertain: the phrase may refer to something understood from the surrounding conversation.

es.literal: Ni siquiera la belleza ha superado a Lola, y tú eres guapa y sensata.

it.literal: Persino la bellezza non ha saltato Lola, e tu sei bella e assennata.

notes.literal: Even beauty did not pass Lola by.
notes.meaning: An affectionate compliment saying that Lola is beautiful.

tr.en: I missed you yesterday and kept looking at my phone until I fell asleep.
tr.fr: Tu m’as tellement manqué hier… Je n’ai pas cessé de regarder le téléphone jusqu’à ce que je m’endorme.
tr.es: Ayer te extrañé muchísimo; me quedé mirando el teléfono hasta que me dormí.
tr.it: Ieri mi mancavi tanto. Ho continuato a guardare il telefono finché non mi sono addormentato/a.

literal: The longing for you struck me yesterday; I kept looking at the phone until I fell asleep.

notes.literal: The longing for you struck me.
notes.meaning: I was overcome with longing for you / I missed you.

fr.literal: La nostalgie de toi m’a frappé(e) hier, je n’ai pas cessé de regarder le téléphone jusqu’à ce que je m’endorme.

notes.literal: Le désir de toi m’a frappé(e)
notes.meaning: Tu m’as profondément manqué; le grand-parent ressent un fort manque et de la nostalgie.

es.literal: Ayer me golpeó la añoranza por ti; me quedé mirando el teléfono hasta que me dormí.

notes.literal: the longing for you struck me
notes.meaning: I was overcome with longing and missed you deeply.

it.literal: Ieri la nostalgia per te mi ha colpito; continuavo a guardare il telefono finché non mi sono addormentato/a.

tr.en: You and your brother are so close—don’t let anything come between you.
tr.fr: Ton frère et toi, vous êtes inséparables. Ne laissez rien vous diviser.
tr.es: Tú y tu hermano sois inseparables. No dejéis que nada se interponga entre vosotros.
tr.it: Tu e tuo fratello siete inseparabili: non permettete a niente di mettervi l'uno contro l'altro.

literal: You and your brother are like the nail and the flesh; don’t let anything separate you.

notes.expression: nta w khouk b7al ddofer w lle7m
notes.literal: You and your brother are like the nail and the flesh.
notes.meaning: A saying about two people who are inseparable and closely bonded.

fr.literal: Toi et ton frère, vous êtes comme l’ongle et la chair ; ne laissez rien vous séparer.

notes.literal: like the nail and the flesh
notes.meaning: Very close and inseparable, like a nail and the flesh.

es.literal: Tú y tu hermano sois como la uña y la carne; no dejéis que ninguna cosa os separe.

notes.literal: como la uña y la carne
notes.meaning: A close bond between two people who should never let anything separate them.

it.literal: Tu e tuo fratello siete come l'unghia e la carne, non lasciate che nulla vi separi.

notes.expression: nta w khouk b7al ddefr w l7em
notes.literal: You and your brother are like the nail and the flesh.
notes.meaning: You are extremely close and inseparable; don't let anything come between you.

tr.en: Don't keep chasing after worldly things; health is the real treasure, my daughter.
tr.fr: Ne cours pas sans cesse après les choses de la vie ; la santé, c’est le vrai trésor, ma fille.
tr.es: No sigas corriendo detrás de las cosas de este mundo; la salud es el mayor tesoro, hija mía.
tr.it: Non continuare a correre dietro alle cose del mondo: la salute è il vero tesoro, figlia mia.

literal: Don't keep running after the world; health is the treasure, my daughter.

notes.literal: run after the world
notes.meaning: Chase after worldly things or concerns.

fr.literal: Ne continue pas à courir après le monde ; la santé est le trésor, ma fille.

notes.literal: my daughter
notes.meaning: A tender way for a grandparent to address their granddaughter: “ma fille.”

es.literal: No sigas corriendo detrás del mundo; la salud es el tesoro, hija mía.

notes.literal: my daughter
notes.meaning: A tender way for a grandmother to address her granddaughter.

it.literal: Non continuare a correre dietro al mondo, la salute è il tesoro, figlia mia.

notes.literal: non continuare a correre dietro al mondo
notes.meaning: don't spend your life chasing worldly things, such as money or success
